The full Kiro workflow in 6 steps: idea to production

The full Kiro workflow in six steps, from idea to production.

1. Set your steering - Product, tech and structure first.
2. Write the spec - Requirements, design and tasks.
3. Review requirements - Check them before any code.
4. Run the tasks - Let Kiro build, step by step.
5. Add a hook - Automate the checks you keep repeating.
6. Ship through a PR - Review the diff and merge.

Docs: https://kiro.dev/docs/
